title: CraftSPH: A high-accuracy and composable differentiable SPH solver implemented in PyTorch
abstract: arXiv:2609.38208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) is well suited to a range of problems, particularly those involving large deformations in fluid dynamics. In recent years, in addition to the advancement of SPH formulations, the development of differentiable solvers has also progressed. However, unified frameworks that flexibly accommodate diverse numerical schemes, including advanced and implicit methods, while supporting continuous extension and updating remain limited. In this study, a high-accuracy and composable differentiable SPH solver, CraftSPH, has been developed. In CraftSPH, major computational operations are implemented as independent modules, which can be combined according to the intended purpose of constructing a solver. translated_title: CraftSPH：一个基于PyTorch实现的高精度、可组合的可微分SPH求解器
translated_abstract: 光滑粒子流体动力学（SPH）非常适合于求解一系列问题，尤其是流体动力学中涉及大变形的问题。近年来，除了SPH格式的不断发展之外，可微分求解器的开发也取得了进展。然而，能够灵活容纳多种数值方法（包括先进方法和隐式方法）、同时支持持续扩展和更新的统一框架仍然有限。在本研究中，我们开发了一个高精度且可组合的可微分SPH求解器CraftSPH。在CraftSPH中，主要计算操作被实现为独立模块，可以根据构建求解器的预期目的进行组合。这种设计使得不同的计算方案能够通过通用组件的组合直观地构建，并允许灵活地纳入新开发的高精度离散化方法。
tldr: 本文基于PyTorch开发了高精度、可组合的可微分SPH求解器CraftSPH，通过模块化设计将主要计算操作实现为独立组件，支持直观地构建多种数值方案并灵活纳入新的高精度离散化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents CraftSPH, a high-accuracy and composable differentiable SPH solver built on PyTorch, whose modular design of independent computational components enables intuitive construction of diverse numerical schemes and flexible integration of newly developed high-accuracy discretization methods.
